# Surf Forecast Dashboard

## 1. Overview

This project is an interactive **Flexdashboard (R)** dedicated to surf
forecasting in **Lacanau**.\
It combines scraped surf data, statistical processing, interactive
visualizations, and decision-support indicators to help surfers choose
the best time to surf based on their level.

The dashboard focuses on: - Wave size evolution - Wind conditions - Best
surf time by skill level - Sea quality index - Clear and aesthetic
presentation

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 2. Technologies Used

-   **R**
    -   flexdashboard
    -   ggplot2
    -   tidyverse
    -   plotly
    -   DT
    -   lubridate
    -   stringr
-   **Python**
    -   Web scraping (external script)
-   **CSS**
    -   Custom header styling
-   **HTML / JavaScript**
    -   UI enhancements (buttons, toggles)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 3. Data Pipeline

### 3.1 Data Source

Surf forecast data is scraped from: -
<https://www.surf-report.com/meteo-surf/lacanau-s1043.html>

### 3.2 Data Processing Steps

1.  Load CSV "carcans_surf_data" generated by the Python scraper
2.  Clean and format dates
3.  Convert wave ranges into numeric values
4.  Compute:
    -   Mean wave height
    -   Surf score (0–100)
    -   Sea quality index
5.  Assign recommended surf level:
    -   Débutants
    -   Intermédiaires
    -   Experts

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 4. Dashboard Structure

The dashboard is organized using **column-based layout**.

### Column 1 – Time Series Visualizations

-   Mean wave height (with LOESS smoothing)
-   Wind speed evolution
-   Interactive Plotly graphs with unified hover

### Column 2 – Data Table & Recommendations

-   Interactive forecast table (DT)
-   Best surf slot by skill level
-   Action button **“Plus de détails”** to reveal explanations

### Column 3 – Indicators

-   Highest wave of the week (valueBox)
-   Sea quality gauge (0–100)
-   Explanation text below the gauge

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 5. Key Features

### 5.1 Wave Trend

-   Improved visual readability of wave evolution

### 5.2 Best Surf Slot by Level

For each surfer level: - Wind thresholds applied - Best time selected
based on wave size - Compact display with expandable details

### 5.3 Sea Quality Index

Composite score based on: - Wave height - Wind speed - Wind direction
Displayed via a gauge indicator.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 6. UI & Design Customization

### 6.1 Custom Header

-   Full-width background image
-   Dark overlay for readability
-   Dashboard title centered
-   Creators’ names displayed in the header

### 6.2 Responsive Layout

-   Column widths controlled with `data-width`
-   Height handled by `vertical_layout: fill`
-   No fixed height distortions

## 8. How to Run the Dashboard

1.  Ensure R and required packages are installed

2.  (Optional) Run the Python scraping script:

    ``` bash
    python3 run_scrap.py <url>
    ```

3.  Open `dashboard.Rmd` in RStudio

4.  Click **Run Document**
